name: woocommerce/payment-gateway-update
label: Update payment gateway
description: Turn a payment gateway on or off, change its checkout title, or move it in the checkout order. Cannot change other gateway settings or credentials.

id.description: Payment gateway ID, such as bacs or cod.

enabled.description: Whether customers can pay with this gateway at checkout.

title.description: Title shown to customers at checkout.

order.description: New position in the checkout order, starting at 0. Offline methods stay grouped, so the response gives the saved position.

title.description: Title shown to customers at checkout. Can be empty.

method_title.description: Name of the payment method or provider.

description.description: Description shown to customers at checkout. Can be empty.

order.description: Position in the checkout order, starting at 0.
